summary: Registers two new DNS SRV protocol labels with IANA that are used to find instant messaging and presence services over SIP. This allows clients to locate such services through DNS.

eli5.summary: To find a chat service for a domain, you look in a directory. This note adds two entries to the list of labels so computers can locate those services.
